artifact_observations.location: Side of the airship envelope and tail fins

The gondola lacks fine structural detail; it appears as a blurry, indistinct block. The suspension cables are faint and lack physical tension clarity, blending slightly into the background sky.
The geometry of the tail fins seems slightly inconsistent with the perspective of the main body, appearing somewhat flat and pasted on rather than integrated into the 3D structure.
